newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 22.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 22 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Russian government will consider budget cuts on Friday.
- New defects at MIR space station prove that the space station, already in orbit for ten years, has started to fall into pieces, says the daily.
- Tuesday's murder of Valentin Sych, head of the Russian Ice Hockey Federation, could have been linked to tax privileges granted to national sports companies.
